result_text:
The export now looks up and names the `all_files.zip` entries from the configured aspect names, so renaming `buildAndDeployment` no longer breaks the export. The reports module compiles offline (`mvn -q -o -pl reports compile`, no errors).

**What changed:** In `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`, `exportJson` no longer hardcodes the five `aspect_*.txt` names. It walks the main, test, generated, build-and-deploy and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that names the loose files, and reads that file for the zip. The default config still yields `aspect_main.txt`, `aspect_test.txt`, `aspect_generated.txt`, `aspect_build_and_deployment.txt`, `aspect_other.txt`. With the renamed aspect, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.

`git-history.zip` needed no separate change. It was only lost because the earlier exception skipped everything after the failed `all_files.zip` write.

**Not verified:** I did not run the renamed-aspect scenario end to end. The package has no existing tests, and I kept the change small instead of adding one. Nothing is committed.
